title: Chapter 638
paragraphs: Chapter 638
Episode 163. Return to the Family (7)
At that moment, near the Calon of the Huphester Alliance, as Jin initially foresaw, the fleets from various forces were gathering.
And they all saw the Sword Garden beginning to change dramatically.
No, they confirmed the dark landscape of chaos spreading throughout the entire city of Calon.
"This is crazy... what is that."
In the captain's room of the flagship Cozec of the Zipple 1st Fleet.
Kadun couldn't take his eyes off Calon, involuntarily slumping down in his chair.
Hedo and Octavia next to him reacted similarly.
After Ron defeated Gliyak at the Sword Emperor's Palace, the remnants of that villain have been eroding the world into chaos until now.
However, there had never been an area of chaos erosion of the level that they are seeing right now.
Even the Mitra Desert, which the major forces used as a waste disposal site, felt no different from a clean area compared to the chaos emanating from Calon now.
They felt as though they could believe that another one of the Five Kings of the Black Sea had awakened in Calon.
"I had no idea that the Sword Garden had this much power hidden. Runcandel controls all of that huge chaos... Damn it, so the identity of the prophet really is the witch Heluram."
The chaos in Calon showed a completely different aspect from ordinary contaminated areas. A perfectly refined form, without a disorderly spread.
Among the major forces, Runcandel was known to be the least developed in terms of technology through chaos control until just yesterday.
Therefore, there were not a few who rashly evaluated that Runcandel was declining, but they were completely wrong.
To the leaders of Zipple, Runcandel was at its peak right now.
The chaos, spreading throughout the entire city like a huge snake, continued to multiply without a break, even as they watched.
Moreover, the hard-to-believe spectacle was not the only one.
"Moreover, that flame... It's the 12th's."
In the middle of the chaos covering Calon, in the area where the Sword Garden was located, a single blue flame was blazing through the chaos.
Even though they were far away, they could not fail to recognize it. The fact that it was Jin Runcandel's fire.
-And unless the 12th Squadron chooses to submit to Runcandel along with the Vamel Alliance, it is inevitable that there will be a battle in the Sword Garden.
-He will never make that choice.
-Then we can use this opportunity to confirm the power that Runcandel has through their battle.
A conversation they had not long ago in the Tower of Talk.
The power of Runcandel, and the power of Jin running amok at their base. Both were far beyond their expectations.
With a chill down his spine, Kadun turned his gaze to Hedo.
"Hedo, you were right. If we hadn't prepared for a full-scale attack as you said, we wouldn't have known that they had such terrible power stockpiled."

"If Runcandel had started to wield that power at us without warning, after they were satisfied with their stockpile. If we weren't fully prepared then... I can't help but think that would have been our ruin."
Octavia chimed in on Kadun's words.

Hedo silently stared at Jin's fire. It looked tiny because of the distance, like a fingernail, but if Jin wished, the flame would rip through the chaos right away and burn them where they were standing.
'I don't feel the power of Murakan that Kadun was worried about... Does it mean they are fighting in the Sword Garden alone?'
Like Lionel and Stame experiencing Jin's level increasing in real time during the battle, the three of them felt the same sensation.
"Sir Kadun."
A wizard entered the captain's room.
"We just confirmed the location of the Kinzelo fleet."
The fleet of Kinzelo was approaching from the opposite direction of Zipple.
With Calon as the center, the fleets of both forces were narrowing the distance towards Runcandel.
"What's the scale?"
"Leading with the flagship Grenil of the 1st Fleet, Sion, Kiki, Alice, Creole. All five major fleets have been deployed."
Cozec, Cozec 2, Lucia, Andion, Piestro, Acadia. Zipple also brought all the strongest flagships of the family and all six fleets.
The strongest and largest forces in the world were gathered in one place.
Soon, Kadun seemed to make a decision and rose from his seat.
"Send a message to Kinzelo at once."
The reporter, sensing the command, bowed his head heavily.
"We should form a temporary alliance and strike at the Sword Garden together. Today, we will destroy Runcandel with them...!"
The reporter left the captain's room.
What will you do if Kinzelo doesn't accept the proposal?
Hedo, Octavia, and the secretaries didn't ask Kadun that question.
Because they were confident that they couldn't refuse.
Zipple and Kinzelo considered each other's power to be similar.
That means neither side could face Runcandel alone as they are now.
It wasn't even a gap that could be expressed as not knowing until they tried to fight.
The power of RuneCandel that each faction's leadership was witnessing was at a level they could never win unless they joined forces when the opportunity presented.
"But, there's one thing that's curious. Why were they hiding their power all this time...... If they had initiated an all-out war at any time, it would have been hard for us to resist."
Phew, Hedo said, exhaling a puff of cigarette smoke.

"They either judged that they were still inadequate to cleanly divide and conquer us and Kinzelo, or there was some danger or constraint that we don't know about, or there was some kind of problem between Rosa and the Prophet."
"It feels too overwhelming to simply be cautious......"
"I'm also uneasy about it, but we can't just back off."
"I think so too, Lord Kadun. The 12th class has caused a civil war, and I don't think there will be a better opportunity than now when cooperation with Kinzelo is possible."
It was an hour later that the mage Kadun sent reached Kinzelo's fleet.
Until then, the battle between Jin, Lionel, and Star continued.
An hour ago, Jin's fire seemed to be slowly piercing through the chaos that covered the Sword Garden, but now it looked like the chaos was desperately suppressing the fire.
Like the chaos that was stretching out across the entire Hupester beyond Calon, the fire was also constantly growing.

"Among those who are left in RuneCandel right now, only the Black Panther could handle a battle of that level. Commander, in my opinion, this is an opportunity that won't come again. The Black Panther will be with the Prophet, and once the battle is over, there will surely be damage to the entire chaos that has become the Sword Garden."
In response to Belact's words, Orgal nodded his head.
[Belact, it's not Rosa RuneCandel who's up against the 12th.]
"Are you saying it's not Rosa RuneCandel?"

[I think the Prophet summoned RuneCandel's old sword. Using the city's residents as sacrifices. If Rosa RuneCandel had been directly involved in the battle, the chaos that has already dyed Calon would have shown signs of instability. That chaos is all spreading through Rosa RuneCandel......]
The commander was convinced.
He believed that every single resident of RuneCandel's city, Calon, had already become material for the creation of chaos.
This time, even Bubar and Ainas couldn't make any useless remarks.
RuneCandel soaked in chaos was also bringing intense fear to those fools.
"Huh, are you saying that they can continue to summon a warrior of that level?"
[If there is enough material, perhaps......as many as they want.]
"Da, Commander. Th, then...... isn't it a good idea to accept Zipple's temporary alliance proposal?"
[We will do that, Jo. You go and prepare for the deployment of the finished Masters.]
"Understood!"
There was a moment of silence.

-[The Vice Commander's opinion is correct. Zipple probably had a similar plan. If we and Zipple both attack RuneCandel when Jin and RuneCandel both have taken a big hit. Even if the Sword Garden is now as powerful as it is, it would be hard to handle.]
Between Jo's departure and Orgal's recall of the words he had said at the meeting a while ago.
Those words had to be corrected.
"Today, even if we combine forces with Gipfel, it's impossible to completely annihilate Runcandel."
“Isn't it that the master does not want to defeat the prophet?”
[Jefferin, you continue to be flippant.]
"Tch. If not for the master, who else can I be saucy to?"

[Her life or death isn't that important to me. What's important is the fact that our position is slightly different from Gipfel's right now. We proceed with the war to damage both Gipfel and Runcandel, suppressing their power and buying some time.]
“Of course, if we're to do it in a way that doesn't reveal that, we have to be prepared to lose quite a bit, right?”
Orgal nodded at Marjiella's words.
[The second goal is the survival of Jin Runcandel.]
“What did you say!?”
Jefferin exclaimed, and Marjiella's eyes sparkled.
[Can't you see that warrior now? He's an unbeatable card to contain Runcandel and Gipfel in the future. He must not die here.]
“Why can't you think that Jin Runcandel could eventually finish us too?”
[Jefferin.]
"Uh, why, why, why are you looking at me like that."
[You seem to be scared.]
Jefferin snorted.
"Yes, I'm a little scared. A certain cruel master is only showing a very shaky figure."
[Don't worry too much.]
“I get it, so now please save my face a little.”
[Jefferin stands at the vanguard. You can use as much of my power as you want, make sure to inflict irreparable wounds on the enemies.]
The moment Orgal said that.
Suddenly, the sky spread over the fleets of the great powers began to darken.
And that sky delivered a woman's voice.
As if God were sending down a voice.
[Gipfel, and Kinselro. I've been feeling quite uncomfortable not being able to tear you guys apart as I wanted over the past years...]
Rosa Runcandel.
It was her voice.
[But now you are tarnishing my final reunion with my son. You will have to pay for that. If it seems too hard to handle, I recommend you run away now.]
As her words ended, from the sky above Calon.
The sight of a massive battleship cutting through the black sky and descending followed.
[If only that were possible…….]
